pert_col: Perturbation identity is the pooled id {CRA|CRI}_{TF} over guide columns {TF}_{CRA|CRI}{k}. There is no obs column whose values are the strings CRA_<TF>.
wt_note: WT column is 0/1 and marks the same cells as exactly one of the boolean PD columns PD14,PD26,PD32. n_WT=6809.
guide_note: No single guide-label column. Each guide is a UMI count column named {TF}_CRA{k}, {TF}_CRI{k}, or NT_{k}. A cell is that guide when the column is a unique strict maximum and > 0. Ties with a positive maximum: 2680 (not given a winner). TF-guide calls that disagree with the CRA/CRI indicator: 270 (not assigned). Pooled perturbation id is {CRA|CRI}_{TF} from columns {TF}_{CRA|CRI}{k}.
nt_note: NT_1..NT_6 are shared guide-count columns: a unique-maximum call to each NT_* occurs in both CRA and CRI cells, so the NT label is not a line id. Modality of an NT cell is the CRA or CRI indicator (those two columns do not overlap and cover every non-WT cell). Unique-argmax NT cells: CRA=666 CRI=1479.
early_note: EARLY = WT at the lowest PD PD14 (n=581).
late_note: The PD of the perturbed cells cannot be determined (perturbed PD values=[], blank PD n=24610). LATE = WT at the highest PD, PD32.
